tasks.short: Inspect the premises, then notify the owner of the maintenance needs.

steps.what: Inspect the condition of the premises on site.
Write a defect list from the notes taken on site.

loop.check: Drop a defect the notes do not mention
loop.why_not_simpler: Handwriting and photos do not fill a form cleanly

steps.what: Decide which maintenance is necessary and which can wait.
Notify the owners of the maintenance needs just marked.
Arrange the necessary maintenance the owner has accepted.

tasks.design: The inspection stays on site. A defect list is drafted from the notes, the agent marks what is necessary, and the owner is notified only of that version. Arranging the work is still a call.
tasks.previous_blocker: Owners heard about defects in a hurried call, with no list to check.
tasks.enabler_now: Notes can be turned into a list. Deciding what is necessary cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Telling a hairline crack from a problem that should stop a sale or a tenancy.
tasks.human_edge: The agent will not notify an owner of a defect they have not stood in front of.

ambition.what: Each defect is marked necessary, later, or not a defect, on the day of the visit.

tasks.altitude: The visit stays. The agent can withhold a notice, and can refuse to arrange work the owner has not accepted.

reach.task: Set which defects must be disclosed
reach.learn: Which defects the broker expects on the notice, and which stay in the file

evidence.claim: Notes can feed a list. The site visit and the decision about what is necessary stay with the agent.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from a site visit to an owner notice and, if accepted, a call to arrange work. The contractor's work is outside this task.
Fields: place, defect, urgency. The agent produces the mark. Fallback: the note stays as text and is not notified.
Upkeep of 3 hours covers defect headings. The class is human. The visit is most of the time.
The design does not score the building.
unknowns: Whether the agent is expected to inspect occupied homes.
research_questions: What share of marked defects does the owner refuse?

incremental.description: Keep defect headings aligned with what owners are actually asked to fix

approvals.approved_version: defect decision the agent made on site

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the visit is the task and the notes are too rough to list. High: the notice writes itself from marked defects, and the visit and the arrangement call stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compare published mortgage rates, then the agent recommends.

steps.what: Load prevailing mortgage rates into a comparison table.
Evaluate mortgage options so clients can obtain financing.
Explain the rates and terms in the meeting.
Draft the options note with every rate tied to a row.

loop.input: The options explained in the meeting
loop.check: Every rate in the note is a row in the table
loop.stop: One draft; a rate with no row is cut
loop.why_not_simpler: A table is not a recommendation

tasks.design: Published rates land in a table. The agent evaluates which options fit and explains them. A note goes out only for the options just explained, each rate tied to a row. No model picks a mortgage.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rates were copied from lender mail into a personal sheet, then talked through from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: Published rates can be listed. Recommending a mortgage is a regulated conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Matching a rate to a client who will actually be offered it.
tasks.human_edge: The agent will not let a table name a winner.

ambition.what: No new service. The agent still recommends, from a table that shows its sources.

tasks.altitude: The meeting stays. The agent can refuse a note that ranks a product, and can send the client to someone allowed to advise.

reach.role: securities and financial services sales agent
reach.task: Explain a financing condition the agent must not answer
reach.learn: Which questions have to leave the room

evidence.claim: A tested model value is not for mortgage lending, so it is not used to pick a rate or a loan.
National rules decide who may recommend a mortgage. Comparing published rates is not that recommendation.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from published rates to a note of options the agent explained. The design disagrees with any reading of this task as an advice engine.
Fields: lender name, rate, term, date published. The client produces the budget they state. Fallback: no row, no figure in the note.
Use the rate sheet the lender already publishes before a scoring model. Upkeep of 4 hours covers products that close.
A model value is not shown. The agent does not obtain the financing in this task.
unknowns: Whether the office is allowed to name a preferred lender.
How often published rates are updated.
research_questions: What share of notes does the agent rewrite before sending?

incremental.description: Remove rate rows the lender has withdrawn

approvals.approved_version: options note the agent explained in the meeting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every client is a special case and the table is only a prop. High: finding the published rates shrinks, and the evaluation and the meeting stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review construction plans with the client and mark the options.

steps.what: Start enumerating available options and features on the plans.

loop.output: Option or feature, with the page it came from
loop.check: Drop a line that has no page
loop.why_not_simpler: Drawings label options in ways a list will miss

steps.what: Review construction plans with clients, recommending options.
Mark which features the clients want priced.
Write the option list the clients asked to keep.

loop.check: Only options the client asked to keep
loop.why_not_simpler: The extract is longer than the decision

steps.what: Send the option list once the agent has checked it.

tasks.design: Options are listed off the plans with a page reference. The agent reviews the plans with the client and recommends. The list that is sent contains only what the client asked to keep.
tasks.previous_blocker: The review relied on the agent remembering the drawing, and the follow-up mail missed options.
tasks.enabler_now: A drawing can be listed. Recommending what to build cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing which option the client actually wants once they hear the price.
tasks.human_edge: The agent recommends against an option the plan makes look easy.

ambition.what: Each option ends the review as keep, drop or price-later.

tasks.altitude: The review meeting stays. The agent can refuse a list that adds options the client did not ask to keep.

reach.task: Point at an option on a plan that changes the installation
reach.learn: Which plan marks must be confirmed on site

evidence.claim: A plan can be turned into a list of labelled options. Recommending one stays with the agent in the room.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from plan pages to a list the client asked to keep. Pricing by the builder is outside this task.
Fields: option name and plan page. The client produces keep or drop. Fallback: leave the option off the sent list.
Upkeep of 3 hours covers option names. The class is human. The meeting is the work.
The extract is a reading aid. It is not a specification.
unknowns: Whether plans arrive as files or on paper.
Who is in the room besides the client.
research_questions: What share of extracted options does the client drop in the meeting?

incremental.description: Align option names with the words the builder uses

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the meeting is the whole task and the extract is discarded. High: listing the options shrinks, and the review stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assemble comparables, then the agent signs the loan value.

steps.what: Assemble recent sales of similar properties into a table.
Drop sales that are not rivals for this property.
Appraise the properties and determine the loan values.
Draft the note so every figure points at a row.

loop.input: Kept sales and the value the agent set
loop.check: Every figure cites a row or is marked as the agent's adjustment
loop.stop: One draft; an unsourced figure is cut
loop.why_not_simpler: A table does not contain the adjustment

steps.what: Sign the loan values and refuse an unsigned model figure.

tasks.design: A table gathers recent sales. The agent drops the ones that are not rivals, appraises on site, and signs the loan value. A model figure may sit in a column. It is never the value. The note cites its rows.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparables were assembled by hand, and a model figure was sometimes copied into the blank.
tasks.enabler_now: Sales records can be listed. A loan value is a signed judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Adjusting for the thing about this property that the sales do not show.
tasks.human_edge: The agent signs a number they will defend, or they do not sign.

ambition.what: No new service. The signed value stays a human act, with the sales visible beside it.

tasks.altitude: The appraisal visit and the signature stay. The agent can refuse to issue a value they did not determine.

reach.role: securities and financial services sales agent
reach.task: See a loan value they must not treat as their own advice
reach.learn: Which figures have to be read as the agent's signed judgement

evidence.claim: A tested model value is not for mortgage lending and is not used as the loan value.
A large buyer quit home buying after a write-down it blamed on price forecasts.
House valuation is not credit scoring under the high-risk points named for that rule.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from recent sales to a loan value the agent signed. The design disagrees with treating this task as something a model can finish.
Fields: address, date, price, size, type, and a model value column if a feed exists. The agent produces the signed value and the adjustment. Fallback: no model column.
Use the sales already in {BI} before a new model. A paid feed is the run cost. Upkeep of 4 hours covers sales that should leave the set.
National rules decide who may sign a loan appraisal. This design does not assume the sales agent may, only that if they do the work, the signature stays theirs.
unknowns: Whether this office's agents are allowed to sign loan values.
Whether a model feed is already paid for.
research_questions: What share of signed values differ from the model column by more than a small gap?

incremental.description: Drop stale sales and keep the adjustment reasons consistent

approvals.approved_version: loan value the agent determined and signed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the visit and the signature are the task, and the table is argued with. High: assembling sales shrinks, and the agent still determines and signs. A forecast is not the value.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Inspections, mortgage meetings, plan reviews and the signed loan value stay. Lists and tables prepare those moments and do not replace them.
reach: Securities and financial services sales agents: take a rate question or a loan value only as the agent's signed work, not as advice of their own
skills_to_grow: Marking a defect as necessary or deferrable
Reading a rate table without crowning a winner
Signing only a loan value the agent determined
role.ambitious_version: An inspection ends in a marked defect list, a mortgage meeting ends in sourced options, and no loan value leaves without the agent's signature.
